get.summary: Liveness check used by probes and OpenAPI examples.
get.description:
Cheap by design: no backend I/O. Pair with `GET /api/readyz` for
dependency-aware readiness.

get.summary:
Readiness check: `SELECT 1` (Postgres), `PING` (Valkey), `HEAD` bucket
(S3) — each bounded by a 2s timeout. Returns `200` when every
*registered* backend passes and `503` when any of them is degraded.
get.description:
Backends with no context registered (e.g. the API-only test router, or
an `Unavailable` object store) are reported as `skipped`, not failures.

post.description: Server-to-server webhook authenticated by the `x-signature` HMAC (manifest `id:{data.id};request-id:{x-request-id};ts:{ts};`). The body is never trusted: the payment is re-fetched from the MP API before being applied. 404 when the payment provider is not Mercado Pago.

200.description: Applied (`ok`), still applying (`accepted`) or nothing to do (`ignored`)

404.description: Mercado Pago is not the configured provider
